title: Rectified Flow
paper_title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
core_mech: 以直线端点路径训练 velocity，并通过 reflow 重新耦合端点以进一步拉直 ODE 轨迹。
core_mech_en: Learns an ODE velocity field along straight linear interpolations x_t = (1−t)x_0 + t x_1 and iteratively straightens trajectories via reflow recoupling.
input_desc: 源噪声 z0 与目标数据 x1 的 coupling
input_en: Coupled pairs (x_0, x_1) from source distribution π_0 and target distribution π_1
output_desc: 沿近直线 ODE 少步运输得到的样本 x_hat
output_en: Nearly straight-line ODE transport trajectories enabling high-fidelity 1-to-few-step Euler generation

adapter.name: Rectified Flow
adapter.mechanism: Regress straight noise/data path velocities; reflow_pairs explicitly recouples a trained ODE's initial and terminal samples.
limitations: Default smoke training is first-round rectified flow; iterative reflow requires user-run endpoint generation and retraining.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
